question: 미국 숨은 성장주 탐색 해줘 - 지금 조정때문에 살짝 빠졌지만 원래 기반이 탄탄한 기업

comparison_period.note: Uniform close-to-close comparison; not a 52-week-high drawdown or one-month return.

scope_note: Selected US-listed mid-cap candidates, not an exhaustive all-market screen. Previously discussed UBER/IOT/ISRG are not re-ranked here.

sources.publisher: Stock Analysis / S&P Global Market Intelligence

facts.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was USD 594.8 million.
Q2 2026 reported revenue grew 15.6% year over year.
Company raised FY2026 organic constant-currency revenue growth guidance to 13%-14% from 10%-12%.
FY2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance is USD 2.25-2.29; this is non-GAAP, not actual realized EPS.
Q2 GAAP operating margin was 14.7% versus 15.8% a year earlier.
Stock Analysis displays trailing-12-month free cash flow of USD 275.04 million at retrieval; a secondary-provider aggregate, not a new quarterly company disclosure.
President and insurance/healthcare/life sciences head Vivek Jetley is scheduled to depart effective October 26, 2026, to become Hexaware CEO.
New senior secured credit facility has USD 1 billion capacity, comprising a USD 400 million term loan and USD 600 million revolver; capacity must not be reported as fully drawn debt.
New credit agreement matures August 18, 2031.
EXL announced completion of the iMerit acquisition.
Q2 2026 revenue grew 11% to USD 182.2 million.
Q2 GAAP operating income grew 20%; GAAP operating margin was 34%.
Q2 operating cash flow was USD 59.6 million.
FY2026 revenue guidance was raised to USD 732-738 million, representing 9%-10% growth.
FY2026 EPS guidance is USD 5.76-5.90 GAAP and USD 7.74-7.88 non-GAAP.
September 11 close was USD 150.28; September 18 close was USD 174.96.
FY2026 Q4 revenue grew 11.0%; recurring and other revenue grew 12.4%.
FY2026 company-defined free cash flow was USD 427.8 million, including deductions for capitalized internal-use software and property/equipment purchases.
FY2026 free cash flow excluding interest on client funds was USD 307.8 million.
FY2026 GAAP diluted EPS was USD 4.92.
FY2027 guidance implies about 7% total revenue growth and 8% recurring and other revenue growth.
Deferred contract cost amortization life changes from seven to eight years in FY2027; company estimates a 120-140 basis-point benefit to adjusted EBITDA margin already included in guidance.
Q2 2026 revenue grew 17.2% and net new business awards grew 28.2%.

derived_metrics.warning: Non-GAAP forecast multiple; not GAAP trailing P/E or a fair-value estimate.

assessments.thesis: Best balance among reviewed new candidates: double-digit organic growth guidance, positive cash generation and a moderate company-adjusted-EPS multiple after a 7.7% September pullback.
caveats: Important division leader transition is company-specific risk; the share decline cannot be attributed solely to market correction.
Acquisition integration, AI substitution/pricing and post-acquisition debt/cash require monitoring.
assessments.conditional_plan: Consider only a small initial tranche if USD 34.5-35.5 stabilizes without persistent new lows. More conservative alternative: recovery and holding above approximately USD 36.5-37.0. Below USD 34.3 close, suspend additions and reassess. These are analyst-selected observation zones, not established support or guaranteed stop prices.
assessments.thesis_break: Organic growth guidance reduction combined with persistent margin deterioration or evidence of major customer attrition.

assessments.thesis: High GAAP operating profitability and positive cash generation with raised full-year guidance.
caveats: Annual revenue growth guidance is only 9%-10%.
Despite being 6.0% below August 31, it is 16.4% above the September 11 close after sharp swings.
Not an obvious bargain at roughly 30x company-guided GAAP EPS.
assessments.conditional_plan: Do not chase; observe a possible USD 165-170 pullback only if selling pressure stabilizes and business guidance remains intact.
assessments.thesis_break: Lowered guidance or weakening customer growth together with margin compression.

assessments.thesis: Established cash-generative payroll/HR software business, but not a clean unchanged-growth market-correction opportunity.
caveats: FY2027 revenue growth guidance slows to about 7%.
Official free cash flow is lower than some aggregators' OCF-minus-capex measure because company FCF deducts capitalized software.
Client-funds interest and amortization-policy change require care when interpreting earnings quality.
assessments.conditional_plan: Wait for evidence that growth has stabilized or valuation compensates for slower growth; no immediate buy recommendation.

assessments.thesis: Strong revenue and new-business growth; nevertheless September 18 close is 3.1% above August 31, so exclude from the uniform September pullback shortlist.

limitations: A recent price decline is observed; a market-only causal attribution is not established.
GAAP and non-GAAP valuation multiples use different denominators and must not be mixed.
Bigdata search was attempted but returned exhausted credits; this report relies on public IR/SEC and market-data pages.
QLYS aggregated cash/net-cash figures were internally inconsistent and were not used.
No trades or monitoring automations were executed.
This standalone research screen does not claim promotion to a repository-wide validated formal evidence schema.
